name: Boiled Bison
storyline:
Looking for the next big story to report on after losing his job as a news anchor, jaded journalist Frankie Loza finds himself driving down a lonely road in the middle of Rural New Mexico, where he comes across a lonely shack on the side of the road advertising "Yummy Buffalo Jerky".

Desperate to find anything to get his job back, Frankie goes to investigate this ominous shack, only to be pulled into a gruesome mystery when he wakes up in an abandoned bison meat processing plant...
summary: A Psychological Horror where you look for a way out after waking up in an abandoned Bison Slaughterhouse. Find a way to escape and uncover the darkest secrets that dwells within The Sterlington Meat Company while evading capture from a crazed murderer with a bison for a head.
